title: Dunki
desc: Four friends from a small village in Punjab set out on a dangerous journey to reach England without the necessary permits and documents.

title: Dabangg 2
desc: Inspector Chulbul Pandey oversees the operations of the local police station in Kanpur. However, things take a turn when he kills the brother of a local politician.

title: Krack
desc: Fiery officer Potharaju Shankar faces off against three dangerous outlaws. Meanwhile, their fierce feud quickly leads to unexpected consequences for everyone involved.

title: Dhamaal
desc: Four lazy friends learn about a hidden treasure in Goa and set out to find it. However, a police inspector learns about their plan and begins to pursue them.

desc: A master thief stumbles upon a secret lead about a shipment of gold ingots being transported from Russia to Romania. Eventually, he recruits a gang of sly criminals to stage a daring heist.

title: Crocodile Island
desc: Stranded passengers must fight against man-eating crocodiles after their plane makes an emergency landing on a remote island.

desc: Muskaan, an unpopular, shy girl, falls for Dino, a charismatic dancer, while on a vacation in Goa with her family. However, things become complicated when her father objects to their relationship.

desc: Dharam and Gajodhar, a father-son duo, claim to be the owners of a massive company to swindle a business tycoon. To add to their troubles, Gajodhar's brother jumps on to the bandwagon.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two married couples are unsuccessful in conceiving and seek medical treatment. However, they end up in a complicated situation after their doctor makes a blunder.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: A woman is forced to abandon her Bollywood dreams after her boyfriend sells her to a brothel. As time passes, she builds strong connections in the criminal underworld and rises to power.

title: Koi ... Mil Gaya
desc: A young man with special needs is influenced by his father's scientific work. He encounters an alien who grants him extraordinary abilities and transforms his life.

title: Khiladi 786
desc: A father who runs a matrimonial agency believes that his son is a failure in life. To prove him wrong, the son takes on the task of finding a match for a gangster's sister.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Radhe
desc: Radhe, a daredevil encounter specialist of the Mumbai Police force, vows to knock down the crime syndicate led by an evil drug lord.
